s: King Ahaziah consults a foreign god, and Elijah foretells his death.
Elijah is taken up to heaven in a whirlwind, and Elisha receives a double share of his spirit.
Elisha helps Israel and Judah against Moab.
Elisha multiplies a widow's oil, raises the Shunammite woman's son, and feeds a hundred men.
Naaman the Syrian is healed of leprosy by washing in the Jordan.
Elisha makes an axe head float and blinds a Syrian army. Samaria suffers a terrible siege.
Elisha foretells plenty, and the siege lifts as the Syrians flee in the night.
The Shunammite's land is restored. Hazael becomes king of Syria.
Jehu is anointed king of Israel and kills Joram and Jezebel.
Jehu wipes out Ahab's house and the worship of Baal.
Athaliah seizes Judah's throne, but the boy Joash is hidden and crowned.
King Joash repairs the temple.
Elisha dies. Even his bones bring a dead man back to life.
Kings of Judah and Israel. Amaziah of Judah is defeated.
A series of kings of Judah and Israel. Assyria begins to take Israel's land.
King Ahaz of Judah copies pagan worship and seeks Assyria's help.
Samaria falls to Assyria and the northern kingdom of Israel is taken into exile for its sins.
Hezekiah trusts in the Lord and reforms Judah. Assyria threatens Jerusalem.
Hezekiah prays, Isaiah prophesies, and the angel of the Lord strikes down the Assyrian army.
Hezekiah is healed and given fifteen more years. He shows his treasures to envoys from Babylon.
Manasseh fills Judah with idolatry and bloodshed, and God declares that Jerusalem will fall. Amon follows his evil ways.
Young King Josiah repairs the temple, and the book of the law is found. Huldah the prophetess speaks God's word.
Josiah reads the law to the people, destroys the idols and keeps a great Passover. He dies in battle at Megiddo.
Babylon's king Nebuchadnezzar takes Jerusalem and carries the king and leading people into exile.
Jerusalem and the temple are burned and Judah goes into exile in Babylon. In captivity, King Jehoiachin is shown kindness.

2: Elijah is taken up in a whirlwind, and his spirit passes to Elisha. Later prophets say Elijah will come again before the day of the Lord.
17: The fall of the northern kingdom
Assyria destroys Samaria and exiles the ten northern tribes. The book explains it as the result of long unfaithfulness to God.
22: The book of the law is found
While repairing the temple, the priests find the book of the law. King Josiah leads a great return to God.
25: Babylon destroys Jerusalem and the temple and takes the people into exile. It is the darkest moment of the Old Testament, yet the prophets keep hope alive.
